S01.label: SF.gov — Apply for a plumbing and mechanical permit
S01.publisher: San Francisco Department of Building Inspection
S01.supports: Permit required before cutting into or replacing pipes, especially covered pipes; license types allowed to apply; inspection before covering pipes; homeowner R-3 restriction.
S01.note: Read directly 2026-11-08. Exact requirement: 'You need a permit before cutting into or replacing pipes, particularly pipes that will be covered by a wall or buried in the ground.'

S02.label: SF.gov — Check if your construction project needs a permit
S02.publisher: San Francisco Department of Building Inspection
S02.supports: Minor repairs to existing interior plaster or wallboard are listed as exempt unless required for fire protection.
S02.note: Read directly 2026-11-08. This is a building-finish exemption list, not a blanket exemption for concealed pipe replacement.

S03.label: 2025 San Francisco Plumbing Code §104.2 (official PDF)
S03.publisher: City and County of San Francisco / American Legal Publishing
S03.supports: §104.2 exempts repair of leaks and unstopping traps/waste pipes only when no cutting into or removal of piping is required.
S03.note: Read directly 2026-11-08, PDF page 5. Exact text: '(1) Repair of leaks not requiring cutting into or removing piping.' and '(2) Unstopping of traps, sewers, vents or waste pipes not requiring cutting into or removal of traps or piping.'

technical.topic: What a traditional trip lever does
technical.verified: Oatey describes a faceplate lever connected to internal linkage and a hollow barrel; lifting the lever drops the barrel to block the tub drain while overflow water can pass through the barrel.

technical.topic: Why access can differ by component
technical.verified: Watco instructions place the overflow elbow and gasket behind the tub, while the overflow plate and drop-cylinder assembly install through the overflow opening; linkage must not kink and can be readjusted by removing the plate/drop-cylinder assembly.
technical.job: Installed manufacturer/model and seized component are unknown; no photos were supplied.

decision_criteria.rule: Prefer one current/active CSLB record carrying both B General Building and C-36 Plumbing as a screening signal for a single prime contract. This is not an exclusive route: BPC §7059 allows qualifying incidental and supplemental work, and applicability to this job is unverified.
Prefer official company pages that explicitly advertise both plumbing and sheetrock/wall repair. A license class alone is not proof the company will self-perform or include drywall.

Require references for concealed bath waste work in occupied units, dust/contents protection, water-shutoff windows, tenant coordination and a pre-close leak test. Platform reviews are leads, not guarantees.
Verify attending crew coverage, general liability, bond and any CSLB disclosure. Exemptions and expiring policies require follow-up.
Compare only written bids with identical access, plumbing, ceiling restoration, protection, testing and permit/inspection scope. Do not rank by the three unlike reported amounts.
